facts.fact: ICASEES, the national statistics institute, runs an Open Data Portal (ODP) at work, with a national workshop planned for end-June 2026 to update its indicators ahead of an ODIN assessment in mid-August 2026; no dataset count is given.
ICASEES confirmed at a regional meeting that a new open licence is integrated on its Open Data portal and institutional website.

note: Document date used for the portal at work (2026-06-10); licence month from the June 2026 meeting.
